defective_pattern: Using cookie-cutter fill-in-the-blank templates and mechanical loop boilerplates to narrate tables.
why_defective: Produces robotic, unnatural, and repetitive Persian academic prose that lacks the dynamic syntactic variation expected in high-quality scholarly writing.
observed_symptoms: Repetitive sentence structures across multiple table narrations.
Mechanical insertion of numbers into fixed string templates.
Lack of natural syntactic and lexical variation.
corrective_remedy: Compose dynamic, authentic Persian academic prose with natural syntactic and lexical variation tailored to each specific table, completely banning cookie-cutter fill-in-the-blank templates and mechanical loop boilerplates, while preserving strict factual objectivity without speculative interpretation.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect identical or highly similar sentence structures enclosing changing statistical values across multiple paragraphs.
